title: BLANK < DATE ( 2024, 1, 1 ) is TRUE: BLANK compares as the zero date

source.quote: All comparison operators except == treat BLANK as equal to number 0, empty string "", DATE(1899, 12, 30), or FALSE
source.supports: < treats BLANK as DATE ( 1899, 12, 30 ) next to a date

source.quote: Integer, Real Number, Currency, Date/time and Blank are considered numeric for comparison purposes
source.supports: BLANK and a date can be compared

derivation: BLANK is compared as 1899-12-30, which is before 2024-01-01, so < is TRUE.
